Indian High Courts Address Forced Marriage and Social Boycott Issues

Two Indian High Courts have intervened in cases involving personal autonomy and societal pressures. The Madras High Court ordered police protection and an inquiry for a couple facing social boycott due to an inter-caste marriage. Separately, the Bombay High Court protected a woman seeking to escape a forced marriage, directing the closure of a missing person case.
